gate_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md three canonical windows. Aggregate EV/PnL must improve, no window may regress EV/PnL, target sample must be >=20 across all 3 windows, survival must stay >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, and concentration guard must pass. A positive private replay still requires shared adapter parity before promotion.

hypothesis: Ticker-level accumulation-base breakouts may only be useful when same-day core A/B entry flow confirms real demand, while excluding same-ticker core overlap to test independent replacement value.
interpretation: The core-flow confirmed accumulation-base breakout source did not clear Gate 4. Do not promote it or answer with nearby accumulation/core-flow threshold tuning on these frozen windows.
negative_reflection: If rejected, same-day core flow did not isolate the old_thin and drawdown failure in exp-20260608-016. The likely reason is that the accumulation-volume proxy still amplifies pro-cyclical breakout beta, or the core-flow dates already capture the best opportunity inside the core stack.
next_evidence_needed: A positive replay lead still needs a shared default-off adapter and parity tests before forward observation. Live activation would need closed forward replacement-value rows and a separate activation-envelope Gate 1-4.

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by sweeping same-day core-flow requirements, same-ticker overlap handling, accumulation lookback, up-volume share, OBV ratio, breakout pct, close-location, volume, ret5/ret20, top-N, hold-day, cooldown, or paper notional thresholds on these frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A retry requires materially new PIT flow/catalyst evidence, closed forward replacement-value rows, or a shared default-off helper reproducing this exact fixed policy for forward observation.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: Core-flow confirmation did not make the accumulation-base source robust enough. It either thinned the useful winners, kept the old-window tail, or selected dates where the core stack already owned the cleaner demand signal.
